summary: FEATURED IMAGE — RESPONSIVE-SIZING + STAR-ONLY VALIDATION (baseline v177 → v178). Verified end-to-end on the live preview URL via Playwright with a real JPEG upload against an existing FullScreenNote (T2). VERDICT: PASS. v178 removes the last remaining editor-area control (the Featured Image chip that had lived in NoteModal above 'Photos & files' since Phase 2). The gold/orange ✳️ header star in FullScreenNote is now the SOLE Featured Image entry point across the entire app: Add / Change / Remove all funnel through featured-image-star-btn. Hero variant remains purely presentational (renders null when empty, image-only when set) and is correctly centered via w-[95%] mx-auto with object-contain max-h-[70vh]. Measurements across desktop/tablet/mobile confirm symmetric margins and responsive scaling. Zero console errors.

notemodal_star_only_validation.verdict: NoteModal no longer renders any Featured Image control surface — star is truly the sole entry point

mobile_390x844.note: ratio drops from ~89% (desktop) to ~82% (mobile) because the writing-column parent is narrower than 95% of viewport at 390px and container padding consumes proportionally more; still symmetrically centered and clearly meets the 'never edge-to-edge, always inset' spec

critical_code_review_comments: Surgical, correct diff — v178 removes ONLY the chip-variant mount from NoteModal and bumps the SW cache. State (featuredImage) and save-payload wiring are preserved, so existing notes with a featured_image continue to load/save without loss when edited via NoteModal.

DEAD CODE (minor cleanup opportunity, not blocking): the entire `if (variant === 'chip')` branch in FeaturedImageBanner.jsx (~60 lines: featured-image-chip-row, featured-image-chip-thumb, featured-image-add-chip, featured-image-change-chip, featured-image-remove-chip, featured-image-file-input-chip) is now unreachable. Recommend deleting the chip variant entirely in a follow-up, plus removing the `variant='chip'` prop default handling. This is a hygiene issue only.

Responsive behavior is correct but the 'w-[95%]' target is only visually met at desktop (89.9%) and tablet (88.8%). At mobile 390px the hero settles at 82.1% of parent — because Tailwind's percentage width applies against the constrained writing-column parent (354px) which itself has inset from viewport padding. The result is still symmetrically centered with visible left/right gutters, which matches the spec intent ('never edge-to-edge'), but if the review request expected exactly 95% at all breakpoints, adjust the parent's padding at mobile or use a fluid `min(95%, calc(100vw - 32px))` clamp.
object-contain + max-h-[70vh] scales correctly: 756px (1080 * 0.7), 716.8px (1024 * 0.7), 590.8px (844 * 0.7) — all natural viewport-height caps hit exactly.

Star-only invariant is enforced at the DOM level: querySelectorAll('input[type=file][data-testid^="featured-image-file-input-"]') returned exactly 1 element (the star-scoped input). No duplicate testids, no residual chip/hero inputs.
No changes were made to FeaturedImageBanner.jsx — the Phase 3A hero simplification from v177 is intact and still passes: no Add-hero chip, no Change/Remove hover controls.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — chip removal from NoteModal, star-only invariant, and responsive hero measurements all pass across 1920/768/390 viewports
